requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement mixes a trigger condition with a functional action. Decomposed into a trigger condition (functional) and a quality requirement (alert visibility) per Pohl §25.2.

source_fragments: When a rejection order is received for a cancellation request, System-A must raise a web alert.

fields.condition: a rejection order is received for a cancellation request

structured_requirements.final_statement: When a rejection order is received for a cancellation request, System-A must raise a web alert.
structuring_notes: Extracted the functional action triggered by the event. The original sentence combined the trigger and the action; the trigger is preserved as the condition for the functional requirement.

fields.condition: upon receipt of a rejection order

structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A must ensure that a web alert is raised upon receipt of a rejection order.
structuring_notes: Extracted the quality attribute (alert visibility) as a separate requirement. The original text implied the alert must be raised; this is formalized as a quality requirement ensuring the alert mechanism functions.
